name: v1-performance-report
description: V1 (HRMForce) performance-timing suite: Playwright-driven frontend page-load (measure.mjs) and login-API (measure-api.mjs) response-time measurements, plus an Excel report generator. Measures real single-request/page-load response times only — NOT a load/stress testing tool. Standalone: zero code dependency on the V1_Automation C# learning project.
